title: Reiwa no Dara-san

thread.title: Dara-san of Reiwa • Reiwa no Dara-san - Episode 10 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters found the episode wholesome, funny, adorable, or excellent.
The family’s eccentric behavior and Dara-san’s interactions with the children were especially popular.
Commenters enjoyed the additional character-focused backstory and were more curious about the eventual conclusion.
Dara-san’s holiday costume, gifts, and other outfits drew enthusiastic approval.
One reaction questioned whether the supernatural protection premise creates an unfairly burdensome obligation, despite enjoying the episode overall.
A commenter felt the season’s planned thirteen-episode length was too short and wanted a longer run.
